subtopic: Issuer Credit Risk and Limits of Principal Protection
source_evidence: you could lose all of your money if the issuer of your note goes bankrupt.
question: Does principal protection guarantee repayment if the issuer of a structured note goes bankrupt?
answer: No. Any promise to repay some or all of your investment depends on the issuer’s creditworthiness. If the issuer goes bankrupt, you could lose all of your money.
